svg.title: spiral-expanding bore - section 10 of 10, bend RRRRRRRRRRUUUU~b, 6 parts on 581x130mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, cut for a 3mm sheet at 0.15mm kerf, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 81-95 of the walk, entering on E and leaving on U, a 11x5 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
